test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All flowers are trees.

All branches are leaves.

No flowers are leaves.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No branches are flowers.

(II) No trees are leaves.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8001f0cefa233b9ef5a2e4f8b2537adbd5fc7a31f89e2e0dea4f918c511f797f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No branches are flowers → Follow (As, all branches are leaves and no flowers are leaves, So, whole branches comes in leaves which cannot be flowers therefore it is definitely true.)

II. No trees are leaves → **Does not Follow** (As, all flowers are trees and, no flowers are leaves all branches are leaves. and, no definite relation is given between trees and leaves, so No trees are leaves can be possible but not definitely true)

Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion (I) follows".
